sentences.text: Calloway-Sum achieved a higher mean ROUGE-L F1 than Pellam-Sum on the held-out scientific domain (Lindqvist-Sci), 36.4% vs 34.9%.

This advantage was observed in both the in-domain news test set (41.8% vs 40.6%) and the held-out scientific domain, suggesting that Calloway-Sum's benefit carries over to at least one non-news domain.
Both models also outperformed the Lead-3 extractive baseline on the held-out scientific domain (36.4% and 34.9% vs 31.7%).
However, no statistical tests were reported, so these differences in means are not established as statistically significant.
